name: Rising
audio: a rush of water, a bright rising harp-like swell and gulls; no speech
world: The reef sea is alive: water cascades and ripples, spray hangs in the sunrise light, dolphins leap, manta rays and turtles glide, fish flash in schools and seabirds wheel overhead.

actions.beat: The sea swells and the surface lifts into a towering column of water, dolphins leaping alongside and manta rays gliding beneath.
{{She}} shoots up on top of the column of water, arms swept wide and up, head thrown back, hair and gown streaming.
The water is released and cascades back in glittering sheets while {{she}} stands exultant on the crest, {{her}} eyes bright with {{MAGIC}} light, looking to the camera.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
